name: jump_through_device_vector
description: Loads a function pointer from a global structure at a fixed offset and calls it, with no other logic. The facts show the call reaches exec.OpenDevice.

name: copy_block_or_report_error
description: When the length argument is non-negative, copies a block from source to destination, handling odd alignment before moving words and then single bytes. Otherwise it stores an error code in a global, calls the reporting routines in sequence and returns the result of a function pointer if one is set.

name: poll_records_until_match
description: Repeatedly fetches a record from an unnamed routine until one has a type field of 2 and a stored value equal to the argument. Each fetched record is passed to the library reply routine before the loop continues.

name: store_value_into_struct_field
description: Calls a library function, writes a register value into a fixed field of the structure pointed to by the address register, then calls another routine. It is a short wrapper around one store.

name: call_handler_library_function
description: Loads a library base pointer from a fixed structure field and calls the function at a fixed negative offset from it. The facts show it is referenced as a handler pointer in data.

name: compare_stored_pair_ordering
description: Compares a stored 32-bit value and a 16-bit value with two register arguments, using the sign of a size argument to choose the comparison direction. It returns zero when the stored pair is on the accepted side and minus one otherwise.

name: claim_free_slot_or_dispatch
description: When a flag byte is set, stores a byte from the source into the destination and returns the routine result. Otherwise it scans a table of records for one whose word field is negative, clears that field and returns zero, and if none is free it sets an error code and calls the reporting routines.

name: store_byte_via_routine
description: Calls one unnamed routine, then stores a byte argument into the location pointed to by the address register. It is a one-store wrapper with no other logic.

name: advance_string_pointer_measure
description: Scans forward through a zero-terminated string from a pointer stored in a structure, writes the advanced pointer back and returns the number of characters consumed. When the pointer is past the limit it takes the error-reporting path instead.

name: copy_bytes_counted
description: Calls an unnamed routine, reads a 16-bit count from its result and copies that many bytes one at a time from the source register to the destination register. The facts show it wraps the copy_memory_block stub.

name: call_two_setup_routines
description: Calls two unnamed routines in order and returns. Its only logic is the sequence of calls.

name: shift_value_by_exponent
description: Derives a shift amount from a 16-bit exponent argument and returns a shifted 32-bit value, negated when the exponent is negative. For exponents outside the handled range it returns zero or falls through to the error-reporting path.

name: call_library_function_via_base
description: Loads a library base pointer from a fixed structure field and calls the function 48 bytes before it. It has no other logic and is referenced as a handler pointer in data.

name: copy_stored_value_into_field
description: Calls a library function, reads a stored 32-bit value and writes it into a fixed field of the structure pointed to by the address register, then calls more unnamed routines.

name: copy_bytes_by_length_result
description: Obtains a 16-bit count from an unnamed routine and copies that many bytes one at a time from the source register to the destination register.

name: move_list_node_or_copy
description: When the source and destination nodes differ and the source lies in the stack range, moves the node links and size to the destination and clears the source size byte. Otherwise it copies a block whose length comes from an unnamed routine.

name: dispatch_library_function_slot
description: Loads a library base pointer from a fixed structure field and calls the function 90 bytes before it. It has no other logic and is referenced by the library dispatch path.

name: copy_block_then_store_word
description: When the length argument is valid, copies a block with alignment handling from source to destination, then stores the 16-bit argument at the end of the destination. Otherwise it stores an error code, calls the reporting routines and returns zero.

name: forward_call_to_routine
description: Calls a single unnamed routine and returns its result unchanged. It is a pass-through with no logic of its own.

name: clear_indexed_entry_and_jump
description: Calls an unnamed routine, zeroes the 32-bit entry at the index held in a register, then makes an indirect call through a pointer whose target is not resolved.

name: clear_indexed_word_and_jump
description: Calls an unnamed routine, zeroes the 16-bit entry at the index held in a register, then makes an indirect call through a pointer whose target is not resolved.

name: spin_delay_loop_then_call
description: Runs an empty countdown loop from a register count, then makes an indirect call through a pointer whose target is not resolved. The loop does no other work, so it acts as a short delay before the call.

name: record_error_and_call_handlers
description: Stores a fixed error code in a global, calls the reporting routines, runs a loop of four calls through a function-pointer table and then makes a final library call. It returns the stored status value.

name: store_code_and_dispatch_error
description: Stores a byte argument as the error code in a global, then runs the common reporting sequence: reporting calls, a four-call table loop and a final library call.

name: raise_fixed_error_code_89
description: Stores a fixed error code of 89 in a global and then runs the common reporting sequence of calls, a four-call table loop and a final library call.

name: store_saved_value_in_struct
description: Pushes a function pointer, calls two unnamed routines, then writes a stored 32-bit value into a fixed field of the structure pointed to by the address register before calling another routine.

name: raise_fixed_error_code_71
description: Sets a fixed error code of 71 in a global and runs the common reporting sequence of calls, a four-call table loop and a final library call. It is referenced as a handler pointer by several callers.

name: raise_fixed_error_code_123
description: Sets a fixed error code of 123 in a global and runs the common reporting sequence of calls, a four-call table loop and a final library call that uses the 390-byte library offset.

name: pass_through_single_call
description: Calls one unnamed routine and returns without any other work.

name: invoke_library_vector_slot
description: Loads a library base pointer from a fixed structure field and calls the function 348 bytes before it, with no other logic.

name: store_result_and_two_words
description: Calls an unnamed routine and stores its 32-bit result plus two 16-bit register values into consecutive fields of the structure pointed to by the address register.

name: normalize_long_to_float_parts
description: Normalizes a 32-bit integer for floating-point style storage by shifting its magnitude until the top bit is set, while keeping a running exponent count. It returns the normalized value and exponent as a 64-bit result.

name: normalize_word_discard_result
description: Shifts a 16-bit argument left in a bounded loop until its sign bit is set, then returns zero whatever the shifted value was. The decompiled output shows no other use of the shifted value.

name: convert_word_to_float_parts
description: Converts a 16-bit signed argument into a normalized 64-bit value by shifting its magnitude until the top bit is set from a fixed starting exponent. An input of zero returns zero.

name: call_library_function_390
description: Calls a library function through a stored library base at a fixed offset of 390 bytes. The decompiled body is only this one indirect library call.

name: store_record_or_report_overflow
description: When the address register plus six lies below a stored limit, writes a 32-bit argument and a zero word into the record and makes an indirect call. Otherwise it stores error code 90 and runs the reporting sequence.

name: allocate_list_node_or_fail
description: If enough space remains below a limit, initializes a list node with zeroed fields, links it in front of the list head and sets its size to ten. Otherwise it stores error code 90 and runs the reporting sequence.

name: clear_byte_test_then_restore
description: Saves a byte at an address built from a base and a 16-bit offset, clears it, then calls an unnamed routine. If that routine's result is nonzero it calls another routine and returns minus one, and in every case it restores the byte before returning.

name: free_memory_via_exec_library
description: Frees a memory block by calling exec.FreeMem through the stored exec library base. The decompiled output shows only this one indirect library call.

name: store_result_and_words_backward
description: Calls an unnamed routine, then writes its 32-bit result and two 16-bit register arguments into the structure at the address register using negative offsets.

name: multiply_extended_float_values
description: Multiplies two extended-precision values by combining 16-bit partial products of their mantissas, then normalizes the 64-bit product. Out-of-range results take the error-reporting path.

name: multiply_float_after_helper_call
description: Calls an unnamed routine first, then multiplies its extended-precision result by a second mantissa using 16-bit partial products. The product is normalized and out-of-range results take the error-reporting path.

name: multiply_float_extra_word_term
description: Multiplies two extended-precision mantissas and also adds a 16-bit operand term to the partial products before normalizing the result. Out-of-range results take the error-reporting path.

name: multiply_float_with_library_call
description: Multiplies an extended-precision value by a 16-bit operand, normalizes the product and returns it. Out-of-range results take the error-reporting path, which calls a library function.

name: copy_block_or_claim_slot
description: When a flag byte in the structure is set, copies a block whose length comes from an unnamed routine and returns a failure word. Otherwise it claims a free record from a table and returns zero, and if no record is free it runs the error-reporting sequence.

name: store_two_bytes_in_state
description: Writes two byte arguments into consecutive fields of a state structure at a fixed offset.

name: dispatch_library_vector_426
description: Loads a library base pointer from a fixed structure field and calls the function 426 bytes before it. It has no other logic and is referenced as a handler pointer in data.

name: fill_memory_with_byte_pattern
description: Fills a memory area with a repeated byte pattern written as 16-bit words. The word count comes from a register argument and the destination pointer is returned.

name: fill_blank_space_words
description: Fills the destination with a pattern of two ASCII space bytes written as 16-bit words. The word count comes from a register argument and the destination pointer is returned.

name: clamp_and_set_status_bits
description: Takes a packed pair of 16-bit values from an unnamed routine, clamps each to a limit from the arguments and passes them on to another routine. It then sets one flag bit in the structure from a stored byte and clears another flag bit.

name: scale_float_by_exponent
description: Scales an extended-precision value by a power of two given as a 16-bit exponent, shifting its mantissa and adjusting the exponent. Out-of-range results take the error-reporting path.

name: add_extended_float_values
description: Adds or subtracts two extended-precision values depending on their signs, first shifting the smaller operand's mantissa to align exponents. It normalizes the result and returns zero when an operand is zero.

name: add_float_mantissas_normalized
description: Adds or subtracts two extended-precision values by aligning their mantissas, then normalizes the result. The sign comparison decides between addition and subtraction.

name: add_packed_float_operands
description: Adds or subtracts two extended-precision operands with exponent alignment and normalization, and returns the high 32-bit half of the packed result. Out-of-range results take the error-reporting path.

name: add_float_values_wide_operand
description: Adds or subtracts two extended-precision values through a wider operand path, aligning their mantissas and normalizing the result. Results that overflow the exponent range go to an unresolved indirect call.

name: find_table_index_or_fail
description: When a stored value is nonzero, scans a table of 32-bit entries for the first entry equal to it and returns that position. When the stored value is zero it stores error code 71 and runs the error-reporting sequence.

name: link_record_or_report_overflow
description: When there is room below the limit, links a four-word record into the list at the address argument, sets its size field to four and makes an indirect call. Otherwise it stores error code 90 and runs the error-reporting sequence.

name: allocate_memory_via_exec
description: Allocates a memory block by calling exec.AllocMem through the stored exec library base. The decompiled output shows only this one indirect library call.

name: dispatch_library_function_pair
description: Loads a library base pointer from a fixed structure field and calls the function 48 bytes before it, with no other logic. The facts also list a second library function at a different offset.

name: link_record_at_list_head
description: When there is room below the limit, initializes a record with the word argument, links it in front of the list at the address argument and sets its size field to six. Otherwise it stores error code 90 and runs the error-reporting sequence.

name: offset_position_pair_checked
description: Adds two 16-bit offsets to a stored pair of coordinates and returns both. It calls an unnamed routine only when three flag fields in the structure are all zero.

name: offset_position_pair_and_notify
description: Adds two 16-bit offsets to a stored pair of coordinates and returns both. When three flag fields in the structure are all zero, it passes the adjusted pair and two more offsets to an unnamed routine.

name: call_routine_if_flags_clear
description: Calls an unnamed routine only when three flag fields in the structure are all zero. Otherwise it returns without action.

name: release_or_register_list_entry
description: For indexes above seven it finds the list entry whose stored value matches and unlinks it, then frees it with exec.FreeMem. For smaller indexes it copies a 16-entry row from a table into the structure, zeroes the word fields and adds a list entry for the stored value when none exists.

name: lookup_cached_library_by_name
description: Compares a name argument against up to five zero-terminated names in a table and returns the cached value for the first match, filling the cache on first use. The referenced text includes translator.library. When no name matches it calls the library opener through the exec base.

name: open_library_via_exec
description: Opens a library by calling exec.OpenLibrary through the stored exec base. The decompiled output shows only this one indirect call.

name: release_matching_slot_entries
description: Clears the state fields that refer to a given pointer and removes that pointer from a table of 16 slots. It then frees the associated memory through exec.FreeMem when its stored pointer lies in a valid range. The referenced text includes GFA-BASIC.

name: compare_record_key_order
description: Stores a key pair and a pointer into a new record when there is room, then compares that key with an existing record and returns zero or minus one. Without room it stores error code 8 and runs the error-reporting sequence.

name: compare_record_key_pairs
description: Compares two records by a 32-bit key and a 16-bit key, with the sign of the size argument deciding the direction. It returns zero when the first record is on the accepted side and minus one otherwise.

name: compare_record_against_key
description: Compares a 32-bit key and a 16-bit key from an unnamed routine's result against a stored record. It returns zero when the record is on the accepted side and minus one otherwise.

name: store_state_tag_minus_two
description: Increments seven state registers when one flag field is zero, stores them in a state block and multiplies a sequence of 16-bit values. If the product passes its overflow check it allocates a record sized from the argument, copies the state into it and links it into the list. The stored tag is minus two.

name: store_state_tag_minus_one
description: Increments seven state registers when one flag field is zero, stores them in a state block and multiplies a sequence of 16-bit values. If the product passes its overflow check it allocates a record sized from the argument, copies the state into it and links it into the list. The stored tag is minus one.

name: store_state_tag_zero
description: Increments seven state registers when one flag field is zero, stores them in a state block and multiplies a sequence of 16-bit values. If the product passes its overflow check it allocates a record sized from the argument, copies the state into it and links it into the list. The stored tag is zero.

name: store_state_tag_one
description: Increments seven state registers when one flag field is zero, stores them in a state block and multiplies a sequence of 16-bit values. When the product's sign test passes it allocates a record sized from the argument, copies the state into it and links it into the list. The stored tag is one.

name: store_state_tag_two
description: Increments seven state registers when one flag field is zero, stores them in a state block and multiplies a sequence of 16-bit values. When a bit test on the product passes it allocates a record sized from the argument, copies the state into it and links it into the list. The stored tag is two.

name: negate_routine_result
description: Calls one unnamed routine, then calls a second routine and returns the negation of its result.

name: relocate_table_entries_by_offset
description: Walks a table of records from its top and, for each entry with a nonzero size code, adds the offset returned by an unnamed routine to the 32-bit pointer fields that refer into the table range. Size codes of minus one and minus two skip or jump over the entry.

name: relocate_table_entries_by_delta
description: Walks a table of records from its top and adds the register argument to the 32-bit pointer fields that refer into the table range. Each entry's size code decides which fields are patched and how far the walk moves.

name: relocate_pointer_list_by_delta
description: Stores the address argument as the list cursor, then walks a list of pointers and adds the register delta to each pointer that falls inside the table range. Entries are moved down by copying their blocks as the walk proceeds.

name: relocate_pointer_list_downward
description: Walks a pointer list and subtracts the register offset from pointers that fall inside the table range, copying entries down as it goes. The list cursor is stored in the structure when the walk ends.

name: shift_entries_backward_with_patch
description: Subtracts a delta from a pointer entry, then walks the list backward, copying each block toward the destination and patching in-range pointers until the list start is reached.

name: compact_blocks_backward
description: Walks a list backward from the given address, copying each block toward the destination and updating pointers that fall inside the table range. The final cursor is stored in the structure.

name: compact_blocks_backward_subtract
description: Subtracts a delta from a pointer and walks the list backward, copying blocks and patching in-range pointers until the list is exhausted.

name: copy_counted_bytes_after_setup
description: Calls two unnamed routines, takes a 16-bit count from the second result and copies that many bytes one at a time from the source register to the destination register. The facts show a library call at a fixed offset.

name: clear_mask_bit_and_free
description: When a flag field is set, reads a record field and, if it is nonzero, clears one bit in a mask word. It then frees the record through exec.FreeMem.

name: copy_block_then_store_byte
description: Copies a block with alignment handling, moving word and byte steps, then stores a single byte argument at the end of the destination. Invalid lengths fall through to the error-reporting sequence.

name: add_delta_to_pointer_range
description: Adds a delta to each 32-bit entry from the given address up to the table end. When the range check fails it calls the handler pointer stored at the start of the structure instead.

name: copy_backward_aligned
description: Copies a block backward from the end pointers, selecting byte, word and longword steps from the low bits of the count so that overlapping blocks copy safely.

name: subtract_delta_from_pointer_range
description: Subtracts a delta from each 32-bit entry from the given address up to the table end.

name: copy_forward_aligned_by_bits
description: Copies a block forward from the source and destination pointers, selecting byte, word and longword steps from the low bits of the count so that the copy is aligned.

name: shift_extended_value_in_place
description: Shifts a packed extended-precision value stored at the address argument by a count held in a 16-bit field and writes the result back. Shifts that are out of range return early.

name: find_slot_index_for_key
description: For keys below 16 it returns the slot value at that index when it is nonzero. Otherwise it scans a table of 16 slots for the key and returns its position. If the key is not found it stores error code 71 and runs the error-reporting sequence.

name: copy_block_direction_aligned
description: Copies a block of a given length, choosing forward or backward direction from the relative addresses of the source and destination. It handles byte, word and longword alignment steps along the way.

name: offset_coordinate_list_points
description: Adds two stored 16-bit offsets to each coordinate pair in a list of four-word entries, storing the results in the structure. It then calls an unnamed routine for each point through a library function at a fixed offset.

name: resolve_record_key_or_load
description: Returns the key directly when it is below 16 and has no table entry. Otherwise it saves a record pointer in a structure field, runs unnamed routines and copies several fields between the structures, then returns the stored key.

name: swap_record_state_and_clear
description: Saves a pointer field in the structure, runs a sequence of unnamed routines, then restores the pointer. It copies several record fields into the structure and clears them in the record.

name: release_handle_if_set
description: Reads a pointer stored at a fixed field of the record and, when it is nonzero, passes it to an unnamed routine followed by three more calls. It does nothing when the field is zero.

name: store_four_words_and_notify
description: Stores four 16-bit register arguments into consecutive slots of the structure and then calls three unnamed routines.

name: clear_port_state_and_free
description: When a stored field is nonzero, clears it and two related fields, then frees the associated memory through exec.FreeMem. The referenced text includes the PAR: and PRT: device names.

name: check_five_entries_or_fail
description: Checks a five-entry table of 16-bit values and returns the given values when all five are nonnegative. Otherwise it stores error code 99 and runs the error-reporting sequence.

name: store_value_in_state_slot
description: Stores the register argument into a fixed 32-bit field of the state structure.

name: multiply_result_by_word_high
description: Calls an unnamed routine and returns the high 16 bits of its low word multiplied by a 16-bit operand. It is a fixed-point scaling step.

name: toggle_stored_flag_value
description: Calls an unnamed routine to initialise a stored flag word when it is zero, then stores one minus a second routine result there. It returns that value shifted right by eight bits.

name: multiply_signed_fixed_point
description: Multiplies two 32-bit values by combining their 16-bit halves with cross terms. When the first operand is negative it calls an unnamed routine and returns the negated result.

name: multiply_fixed_point_halves
description: Multiplies two 32-bit values by combining their 16-bit halves with cross terms and returns the 32-bit product.

name: post_request_when_owner_matches
description: Returns early unless the stored owner pointer equals the argument. Otherwise it waits until a stored value is set, marks the associated request record with a fixed status and calls a library function at a fixed offset.

name: post_request_with_arguments
description: Waits until a stored value is set, then writes the register and address arguments into the associated request record with status three and calls a library function at a fixed offset.

name: dispatch_library_function_450
description: Loads a library base pointer from a fixed structure field and calls the function 450 bytes before it. The decompiled body is only this indirect call.

name: format_float_as_decimal_text
description: Writes a sign character and then converts an extended-precision value into decimal digits, scaling it by powers of ten and writing the result to a text buffer. Zero is written as a single digit, and the routine calls several unnamed helpers.

name: format_scientific_text_digits
description: Writes the digit characters of a value into a text buffer and appends an exponent marker with a sign. It is the exponent-notation path of the number-to-text code.

name: format_float_text_fixed_point
description: Builds printable text from a digit buffer and an exponent, using fixed notation with a decimal point and trimming trailing zeros when the exponent is in range. A zero value is written as a single zero digit.

name: dispatch_library_function_330
description: Loads a library base pointer from a fixed structure field and calls the function 330 bytes before it, with no other logic.

name: compute_offset_from_record_field
description: Reads a 16-bit coordinate from the active record, or from the secondary record when no active record exists, and returns its difference from a stored 16-bit value. It returns zero when neither record exists.

name: invoke_unnamed_routine_only
description: Calls one unnamed routine and returns. It contains no other logic.

name: map_condition_to_minus_one
description: Calls an unnamed routine and returns minus one when the zero flag it leaves set is true, or zero otherwise.

name: map_condition_inverse_result
description: Calls an unnamed routine and returns zero when the zero flag it leaves set is true, or minus one otherwise.

name: dispatch_library_function_90
description: Loads a library base pointer from a fixed structure field and calls the function 90 bytes before it, with no other logic.

name: pack_scaled_components
description: Calls an unnamed routine and combines its 64-bit result into a 32-bit packed number, scaling the low and high parts by fixed factors.

name: read_library_base_quad_field
description: Returns a 64-bit value from a fixed field of the library base referenced by a structure field.

name: dispatch_library_function_174
description: Loads a library base pointer from a fixed structure field and calls the function 174 bytes before it, with no other logic.

name: release_block_and_return_size
description: Returns the size word of a memory block header at the address argument. When the block lies in the stack-range area it marks the block free and updates the free-list head.

name: select_slot_record_by_index
description: For an index below 16, stores the index as the active slot and returns the record kept for it. An empty slot is filled through an unnamed routine and its fields are copied from the argument registers.

name: select_slot_record_by_register
description: Selects the active slot record from a 16-slot table using a register index, filling an empty slot through an unnamed routine. The referenced text includes GFA-BASIC-Screen.

name: parse_prefixed_number_text
description: Temporarily terminates a text buffer at the given length, skips leading spaces and parses an integer that may carry an ampersand base prefix such as the octal form. It then restores the byte it overwrote.

name: initialise_table_region
description: When the cursor equals the stored base, stores a size from an unnamed routine as the table base, computes the end pointer and zeroes a region of 16-bit words.

name: reserve_hunk_table_region
description: Raises a requested size to at least 1000, and when the cursor matches the stored base it reserves and clears a table region. Its values are compared with AmigaDOS hunk type codes, which points to executable loading code.

name: dispatch_library_function_42
description: Loads a library base pointer from a fixed structure field and calls the function 42 bytes before it, with no other logic.

name: open_required_amiga_libraries
description: Opens a list of Amiga libraries by name through exec.OpenLibrary, including dos.library, and storing each base in a fixed slot. It also allocates memory and sets up task and message state through exec.AllocMem, exec.FindTask and exec.GetMsg, then waits on a port with exec.WaitPort. Failure branches jump to a teardown path.

name: clear_region_and_build_table
description: Clears a region of 16-bit words sized from a global, then walks a zero-terminated byte table and writes entries into the region according to each byte's value and the alignment of the destination.

name: return_immediately_stub
description: Returns to the caller without doing anything. The decompiled body is empty.

name: parse_decimal_number_text
description: Parses decimal text from a string pointer, skipping leading spaces, reading an optional sign, fraction digits and exponent, and stores the value as an extended-precision result.

name: parse_decimal_text_entry_two
description: Enters the decimal-number parser at a second entry point. It skips leading spaces, reads an optional sign and then the digits, storing the result as an extended-precision value.

name: parse_decimal_text_entry_three
description: Enters the decimal-number parser at a third entry point. It skips leading spaces, reads an optional sign and then the digits, storing the result as an extended-precision value.

name: parse_decimal_text_entry_four
description: Enters the decimal-number parser at a fourth entry point. It skips leading spaces, reads an optional sign and then the digits, storing the result as an extended-precision value.

name: parse_decimal_text_entry_five
description: Enters the decimal-number parser at a fifth entry point. It skips leading spaces, reads an optional sign and then the digits, storing the result as an extended-precision value.

name: parse_decimal_number_full
description: Parses decimal text including sign, fraction digits and exponent, and stores the value as an extended-precision result. It calls six unnamed helpers during the conversion.

name: copy_bytes_counted_by_routine
description: Obtains a count from an unnamed routine and copies that many bytes one at a time from the source register to the destination register.

name: store_byte_after_setup_call
description: Calls one unnamed routine, then stores the byte argument at the address register.

name: store_word_after_setup_call
description: Calls one unnamed routine, then stores the 16-bit argument at the address register.

name: store_long_after_setup_call
description: Calls one unnamed routine, then stores the 32-bit argument at the address register.

name: resize_or_allocate_block
description: Allocates a block of the requested size from the free area below a stored top pointer and records the size in the block header. If the existing block already has that size it is returned unchanged, otherwise the old block is released first.

name: allocate_slot_block_from_table
description: Finds the first free entry in a table of up to 1000 records, then allocates a block of the requested size below the stored top pointer and records it in that entry. A zero size clears the entry and returns.

name: store_byte_after_routine_call
description: Calls one unnamed routine, then stores the byte argument at the address register.

name: store_word_after_routine_call
description: Calls one unnamed routine, then stores the 16-bit argument at the address register.

name: store_long_after_routine_call
description: Calls one unnamed routine, then stores the 32-bit argument at the address register.

name: free_block_and_merge_neighbours
description: Walks the block list from the top pointer and merges the given block with adjacent free neighbours, linking the combined block back into the list. It returns the argument pair.

name: compute_free_space_remaining
description: Calls an unnamed routine, then returns the distance between the stored top pointer and the address argument, which is the free space remaining.

name: mark_block_free_in_chain
description: When the header address lies in the stack-range area, clears its marker byte and, if the block size is nonzero, writes the negated offset into the link word of the chain entry.

name: store_two_strings_with_lengths
description: Stores a pointer to the first zero-terminated string argument, measures it and the second string, saves both lengths in the structure and then calls a library function at a fixed offset.

name: dispatch_library_function_96
description: Loads a library base pointer from a fixed structure field and calls the function 96 bytes before it, with no other logic.

name: relink_slot_record_node
description: Computes the six-byte slot record for an index and, when it differs from the source node, moves the node links into the slot. The source size byte is cleared when the source lies in the stack range.

name: return_empty_stub
description: Does nothing and returns to the caller. The decompiled body is empty.

name: scale_mantissa_by_exponent
description: Shifts a 16-bit mantissa argument left until its top bit is set, adjusting the exponent held in the second register. It returns early for negative or zero inputs.

name: read_slot_record_pair
description: Reads the slot record for an index. When the record has a nonzero size and a valid pointer it returns the record's first two words and clears the error word, otherwise it sets the error word to minus one and returns the register arguments.

name: write_buffer_chunk_or_fail
description: Writes data into a chunked buffer and allocates a new chunk through an unnamed routine when the current one is full. A negative request stores error code 24 and runs the error-reporting sequence.

name: append_byte_to_buffer_record
description: Appends a byte to a record buffer, incrementing its count and setting a flag bit in the header. A negative request stores error code 24, and a full buffer stores error code 220.

name: adjust_counter_and_clear_slot
description: Adds the difference of two register values to a stored counter and clears a two-word record. It calls an unnamed routine with a value from the state table and, when that result is nonnegative, calls another routine and returns the record's two words.

name: clear_slot_and_dispatch_library
description: Stores a fixed sentinel value in a record field and clears a slot in the state table. It then calls a library function at a fixed offset when the sign flag is clear.

name: update_pointer_offset_or_fail
description: Adjusts a stored 16-bit pointer offset inside a record when the new value fits its range, and otherwise recomputes the record and calls unnamed routines. A negative request stores error code 24.

name: store_slot_result_or_fail
description: Clears the first word of the record, calls unnamed routines with a slot value, and stores the result word in the record when the value is nonnegative. Otherwise it stores an error code from a routine and runs the reporting sequence.

name: raise_error_with_routine_code
description: Runs the common error-reporting sequence with the error code produced by an unnamed routine.

name: release_record_if_matching
description: Clears the record's links and marker bit, calls an unnamed routine with its size and, when the result equals the stored size, adds the result to a field and returns the stored pair. Otherwise it reports through the error sequence.

name: store_count_or_report_error
description: Clears the first word and calls an unnamed routine. A positive result is stored with a running total and returned. A zero result returns when a state word is set and otherwise reports error code 13, while a negative result reports error code 26.

name: check_state_word_or_report
description: Returns the register pair when the sign flag is clear and the state word is set. A zero state word reports error code 26, and a state word with a zero low byte reports error code 13.

name: return_without_action
description: Returns to the caller without doing anything.

name: raise_error_code_26
description: Runs the common error-reporting sequence with error code 26.

name: accumulate_result_or_report
description: Clears the first word and calls an unnamed routine. A positive result is added to a running total in the record and returned early when it equals a stored limit. Other results fall through to error codes 26 or 13 according to the state word.

name: remove_list_entry_and_free
description: When a stored handle is set, finds the list entry carrying that handle, unlinks it and frees it through exec.FreeMem. The routine then returns.

name: dispatch_library_function_84
description: Loads a library base pointer from a fixed structure field and calls the function 84 bytes before it, with no other logic.

name: copy_node_fields_checked
description: Copies a block from the pointer argument into a new node when there is room below the limit and the argument lies outside the stack-range area. Otherwise it calls unnamed routines to allocate space first.

name: multiply_signed_16bit_operands
description: Multiplies two 16-bit operands after normalising their signs, combining partial products into a 32-bit result. When the first operand is negative it calls an unnamed routine and returns the negated product.

name: multiply_unsigned_partial_products
description: Multiplies two unsigned operands by ordering them by size and combining their 16-bit partial products into a 32-bit result.

name: wait_for_port_message
description: Calls exec.WaitPort through the stored exec library base to block until a message arrives on the port. The decompiled output shows only this indirect call.

name: check_count_sign_for_status
description: Checks a counter argument's sign and zero state. When the counter is zero it stores status zero and runs the error-reporting sequence, and otherwise it continues through an unnamed routine.

name: check_zero_count_status
description: Calls an unnamed routine. When the counter argument is zero it stores status zero and runs the error-reporting sequence, otherwise it returns the call result.

name: read_pair_or_report_status
description: Reads a 32-bit value and a 16-bit value from the record and passes the length field to an unnamed routine. A zero length stores status zero and runs the error-reporting sequence.

name: read_record_pair_for_length
description: Reads a 32-bit value and a 16-bit value from the record and checks a length argument. A zero length stores status zero and runs the error-reporting sequence, while a positive length continues the record update.

name: process_record_for_length
description: Updates a record for a length argument by calling an unnamed routine. A zero length stores status zero and falls into the error-reporting sequence.

name: create_flagged_record_or_fail
description: Creates a record from the register arguments, storing its flag word and linking the previous pointer, and sets two extra fields when flag bit 11 is set. A negative flag byte stores error code 99 and runs the reporting sequence.

name: store_clipped_rectangle_record
description: Stores a four-word rectangle and a 32-bit extra value in the record, then clips its extent against limits taken from a second structure. Unnamed routines complete the update.

name: load_state_from_slot_entry
description: Finds the table slot whose pointer equals the argument, then copies four stored 32-bit fields from that slot into the state block.

name: compute_record_extent_fields
description: Reads position and size fields from the active record, falling back to a default record when none is set, and computes a clipped extent. Unnamed routines complete the calculation.

name: copy_text_template_into_buffer
description: Stores four 16-bit arguments in the structure, then copies a 19-word template into a buffer chosen from the structure. The referenced text includes GFA-BASIC.

name: store_pair_and_mark_flag
description: Stores values returned by unnamed routines into state fields and sets flag bit 0 in a state byte when they are nonzero. It then calls more routines to finish the setup.

name: drain_queue_and_clear_state
description: Calls an unnamed routine until it returns zero, sets a flag bit in the state byte, clears four state fields and frees a block through exec.FreeMem.

name: create_record_or_report_failure
description: Creates a record through an unnamed routine and stores the state value in its field, returning the record. If creation fails it stores error code 88 and runs the reporting sequence. The facts show a call to the add-port library stub.

name: set_console_request_fields
description: Stores a request pointer and a type value of four in an I/O request, calls an unnamed routine and copies two request fields into the state block. The referenced text includes console.device.

name: clear_flag_and_free_block
description: Clears flag bit 0 in a state byte and frees a memory block through exec.FreeMem.

name: store_state_value_in_result
description: Calls an unnamed routine and, when its result is nonzero, stores the state value into a fixed field of that result.

name: set_names_and_dispatch_library
description: Chooses a record from the state, or a fallback record when none is set, stores two string pointers in it and calls a library function at a fixed offset of 282 bytes.

name: build_48_byte_record_chain
description: Allocates a block through an unnamed routine and fills consecutive 48-byte records with a type code of five. It stores a pointer in each record and clears a flag bit in the state byte as it goes.

name: set_request_type_and_dispatch
description: Sets a type of two and a state pointer in a request record, marks its count as one and calls a library function at a fixed offset of 462 bytes.

name: set_request_type_after_calls
description: Calls unnamed routines first, then sets a type of two and a state pointer in a request record, marks its count as one and calls a library function at a fixed offset of 462 bytes.

name: find_table_entry_pointer
description: Scans a table of 32-bit pointers for the argument and stops at the matching entry. The decompiled output shows only this scan and returns nothing.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Decodes as data rather than code, so the decompiled output is only a halt on bad data. It is a stub with no behaviour to describe.

name: init_chipset_registers_and_table
description: Reads chipset status registers, writes the interrupt enable register with a mask and fills a table with fixed word values. It then calls an unnamed routine.

name: init_chipset_colour_and_table
description: Reads chipset status registers, writes the interrupt enable register and sets the COLOR00 colour register while filling a table with fixed word values. It then calls an unnamed routine.

name: decode_variable_length_codes
description: Runs a bit-controlled loop that fetches values from an unnamed routine and sums them while each fetched value equals three. It acts as the variable-length decoding loop of the data stream.

name: return_if_shifted_bits_zero
description: Tests a shifted bit count and returns in both cases. The routine has no effect.

name: read_bits_from_stream
description: Shifts bits out of a bit buffer one at a time, fetching a new byte from the source pointer when the buffer empties, and repeats for a count held in a register. It is a bit-stream reader.
